results.description: LoRA model trainer, advanced version

scale_lr.title: Scale Lr
scale_lr.description: Scale the learning rate by the number of GPUs, gradient accumulation steps, and batch size.

lora_rank.title: Lora Rank
lora_rank.description: Rank of the LoRA. Larger it is, more likely to capture fidelity but less likely to be editable. Larger rank will make the end result larger.

lora_scale.title: Lora Scale
lora_scale.description: Scaling parameter at the end of the LoRA layer.

resolution.title: Resolution
resolution.description: The resolution for input images. All the images in the train/validation dataset will be resized to this resolution.

color_jitter.title: Color Jitter
color_jitter.description: Whether or not to use color jitter at augmentation.

use_template.description: The template to use for the inversion.

clip_ti_decay.title: Clip Ti Decay
clip_ti_decay.description: Whether or not to perform Bayesian Learning Rule on norm of the CLIP latent.

instance_data.title: Instance Data
instance_data.description: A ZIP file containing your training images (JPG, PNG, etc. size not restricted). These images contain your 'subject' that you want the trained model to embed in the output domain for later generating customized scenes beyond the training images. For best results, use images without noise or unrelated objects in the background.

cached_latents.title: Cached Latents
cached_latents.description: Whether or not to cache VAE latent.

lora_dropout_p.title: Lora Dropout P
lora_dropout_p.description: Dropout for the LoRA layer. Reference LoRA paper for more details.

lr_warmup_steps.title: Lr Warmup Steps
lr_warmup_steps.description: Number of steps for the warmup in the lr scheduler.

weight_decay_ti.title: Weight Decay Ti
weight_decay_ti.description: The weight decay for the TI.

learning_rate_ti.title: Learning Rate Ti
learning_rate_ti.description: The learning rate for the TI.

train_batch_size.title: Train Batch Size
train_batch_size.description: Batch size (per device) for the training dataloader.

weight_decay_lora.title: Weight Decay Lora
weight_decay_lora.description: The weight decay for the LORA loss.

continue_inversion.title: Continue Inversion
continue_inversion.description: Whether or not to continue inversion.

initializer_tokens.title: Initializer Tokens
initializer_tokens.description: The tokens to use for the initializer. If not provided, will randomly initialize from gaussian N(0,0.017^2)

learning_rate_text.title: Learning Rate Text
learning_rate_text.description: The learning rate for the text encoder.

learning_rate_unet.title: Learning Rate Unet
learning_rate_unet.description: The learning rate for the unet.

max_train_steps_ti.title: Max Train Steps Ti
max_train_steps_ti.description: The maximum number of training steps for the TI.

placeholder_tokens.title: Placeholder Tokens
placeholder_tokens.description: The placeholder tokens to use for the initializer. If not provided, will use the first tokens of the data.

train_text_encoder.title: Train Text Encoder
train_text_encoder.description: Whether to train the text encoder

lr_warmup_steps_lora.title: Lr Warmup Steps Lora
lr_warmup_steps_lora.description: Number of steps for the warmup in the lr scheduler.

continue_inversion_lr.title: Continue Inversion Lr
continue_inversion_lr.description: The learning rate for continuing an inversion.

gradient_checkpointing.title: Gradient Checkpointing
gradient_checkpointing.description: Whether or not to use gradient checkpointing to save memory at the expense of slower backward pass.

max_train_steps_tuning.title: Max Train Steps Tuning
max_train_steps_tuning.description: The maximum number of training steps for the tuning.

placeholder_token_at_data.title: Placeholder Token At Data
placeholder_token_at_data.description: If this value is provided as 'X|Y', it will transform target word X into Y at caption. You are required to provide caption as filename (not regarding extension), and Y has to contain placeholder token below. You are also required to set `None` for `use_template` argument to use this feature.

gradient_accumulation_steps.title: Gradient Accumulation Steps
gradient_accumulation_steps.description: Number of updates steps to accumulate before performing a backward/update pass.

use_face_segmentation_condition.title: Use Face Segmentation Condition
use_face_segmentation_condition.description: Whether or not to use the face segmentation condition.
